definition: a large entrance or reception area
description: A woman in a dark suit pushes through the glass doors of a bank. At the counter a clerk feeds banknotes through a counting machine. She then walks into the wide marble entrance hall, a big information screen on the wall and a row of staffed desks along the side. At the back a man in a suit turns the wheel of the huge round steel door and she stares into the corridor of deposit boxes behind it.

en.question: What is the woman staring into?

es.answer: Está mirando fijamente el interior de una cámara acorazada.
phrases: mirar fijamente el interior de la cámara acorazada
es.question: ¿Qué está mirando fijamente la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle regarde fixement dans la chambre forte de la banque.
phrases: regarder fixement dans la chambre forte
faire fonctionner une compteuse de billets
